card.name: Third digit in phone numbers and counts
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 7, 9, 1 or 0) that comes right after two digits, making the third digit of a three-digit number. Seen mostly in phone area codes and exchanges, and also in counts like 211 prisons or 309 patients.

modes.label: Phone area code
modes.description: Third digit of an area code or exchange in a contact phone number.

modes.label: Counts in running text
modes.description: Third digit of a three-digit or longer count of people, items or visits.
